title: 🌏 Auckland Asian Networking Night
description:
Looking to meet new people, expand your professional network, or simply enjoy meaningful conversations over a drink?

Auckland Asian Networking Night is a relaxed community meetup inspired by Auckland's diverse Asian community, bringing together people from all backgrounds to connect, share experiences, and build genuine relationships.

You don't have to be Asian to join. If you enjoy meeting people from diverse backgrounds and appreciate Asian cultures, you're more than welcome.

No presentations. No formal agenda. Just good conversations.

👥 WHO'S THIS FOR?
Whether you're:

* A professional from any industry
* An entrepreneur or small business owner
* A freelancer or creative
* A student or working holiday maker
* Looking for a new career opportunity
* Or simply interested in meeting new people

💬 WHAT TO EXPECT
Grab a drink, introduce yourself, and join any conversation that interests you.

There's no fixed seating, no scheduled activities, and no pressure. Simply move around, meet different people, and enjoy conversations at your own pace.

You might leave with:

* New friends
* Professional connections
* Career insights
* Business opportunities
* Collaboration ideas
* Or simply a great evening with interesting people

Most people attend on their own, so don't worry if you're coming solo. We'll help you feel welcome.

📍 EVENT DETAILS

* Location: Mixed 1981 Cafe, 50 Fort St, Auckland CBD, Auckland
* Time: 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM (feel free to arrive a little earlier to grab a drink)
* Frequency: Every two weeks
* Capacity: Limited spaces available
* Entry: FREE for Hanahub members (Free to sign up at [hanahub.co.nz](https://www.hanahub.co.nz/))

☕ This event is proudly sponsored by Mixed 1981. All attendees are required to purchase at least one drink, and Hanahub members can enjoy 15% OFF food and drinks by showing their Hanahub member profile on the night.

🍪 Korean snacks will be served on the night, so come and enjoy a taste of Korea while you mingle.

Join us for another Hack The Box meetup in Auckland! Whether you're thinking about being a hacker or are already a seasoned one, this event has something for everyone.

At the end, we will do a raffle where we will give out HTB prizes, such as VIP access to the platform and HTB Academy cubes.

This is an on-site event in Auckland CBD.

* A laptop.
* A HTB account.
* Discord application.

* Follow all rules and guidelines in the **[HTB TOS: HTB Terms of Service](https://www.hackthebox.com/tos)**
* Active HTB content cannot be shared publicly. Retired challenges or machines are fair game.
* **AUT CSI Club** host the event to support the growth of the local cybersecurity community and to support students and professionals in their journeys to learn. Respect for the venue and people is expected from all attendees.

**ADDITIONAL NOTES**

* Join our Discord for event discussion, upcoming event announcements, and CTFs here: **[https://discord.gg/aDWymsDxWu](https://discord.gg/aDWymsDxWu)**
* Free parking is not available at the location.

title: On Body and Soul (Hungary 2015, 1 hr 50)
description:
I am really excited about showing this film. It was nominated for the Academy Aaward for Best Foreign Language Film and won the Golden Bear Award at the Berlin International Film Festival.

The film depicts a romance in which two people share a re-occuring dream - that they are a pair of deer in a forest. The film is beautifully shot (you will love deer after this). A lot could be said about this film, but it takes us into world of autism and socially damaged indiividuals

The Fictionmachine reviewer wrote "technically it is superb. Cinematographer Máté Herbai turns every shot into a beautifully composed painting. The film’s use of colour is superb. The scenes of the two deer are remarkable to watch, and capture the animals in such an emotive fashion."

Some won't get it, but nothing new in thw world of cinema there!
